title: LibreDWG/ezdxf SAT DXF framing and terminal-block crosscheck
mode: Primary-source web research and read-only local plan/source crosswalk
scope: Compare Autodesk's published 3DSOLID carrier contract with source-level SAT DXF framing in LibreDWG, ezdxf, ACadSharp, and local libdxfrw.
Separate group-code framing, line/chunk boundaries, SAT-v1 caret conversion, SAB-to-SAT block retention, parser reconstruction, ACIS semantics, and native acceptance.
Refine the existing PAR-07/S8 composed checkpoint while preserving fast local validation, no external fixture files, and self-unblocking implementation cadence.

sources.observed: Group 1 is described as proprietary data in multiple lines under 255 characters; group 3 is additional lines when the preceding group-1 string exceeds 255 characters.
sources.limits: The table does not prescribe token-aware boundaries, caret conversion, or acceptance by a particular parser/native consumer.

sources.observed: The reader starts an SAT line at group 1 and appends following group-3 values. The writer emits each SAT line as group 1 up to 255 characters followed by group-3 chunks for the remaining characters; the same source describes SAB storage in ACDSDATA for DXF 2013+.
sources.limits: Source-level parser/writer behavior is a structural comparator only, not ACIS semantic geometry or native application acceptance.

sources.project: LibreDWG DXF writer and SAB-to-SAT source
sources.revision: Mutable master source and NEWS observed 2026-10-20; exact commit was not captured and no executable was built or run.
sources.observed: The DXF dxf_3dsolid path writes SAT lines using repeated group 1, prefers an embedded newline before its current cut, otherwise limits chunks to 255 bytes, and applies SAT-v1 caret-space conversion. The SAB-to-SAT converter uses 4096-byte storage blocks, sets the final block count plus a zero-size/null sentinel, and comments that a prior missing +1 dropped the last block; NEWS records a last-SAT-block DXF export fix.
sources.limits: Current master is mutable. This source path is peer implementation evidence, not a normative rule or proof of downstream acceptance; pin an exact commit/tag before any run.

sources.observed: The proposal reports legacy DXF SAT output in groups 1 and 3 and proposes a whitespace-aware cut policy.
